root_cause: A single smoke_Snippets_Softmax accuracy test (ARM64 cross-compiled CPU plugin functional tests) produced a wildly out-of-range actual value (2.6e+23 vs expected ~2.5e-4), i.e. uninitialized/garbage memory rather than a systematic numeric drift. This exact signature has recurred twice previously (PRs 38056, 37526) on unrelated changes, and the current PR #40020 only touches NPUW GQA compiled-model code (src/plugins/intel_npu), which has no code path overlap with the CPU plugin's Snippets Softmax emitter/kernel. This strongly indicates a pre-existing, intermittent flakiness in the Snippets Softmax reference-vs-actual comparison on the ARM64 CPU path, unrelated to the PR's changes.
reproduction_steps: Build the CPU plugin for ARM64 cross-compilation and run: ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_Snippets_Softmax*CompareWithRefImpl*IS[0]*Axis=-1*#N=1_#S=1*targetDevice=CPU. The failure may not reproduce on every run (observed as 1/72577 smoke tests failing); repeated runs or re-running under ASAN/valgrind may help surface an uninitialized-memory root cause.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CPU functional tests job for PR #40020 merge-queue run; a rerun is expected to pass since the PR's NPUW changes are unrelated to this CPU Snippets Softmax test.
File/track a dedicated flaky-test ticket for smoke_Snippets_Softmax/Softmax.CompareWithRefImpl on ARM64 CPU, referencing prior occurrences in PR 38056 and 37526.

Investigate potential uninitialized buffer read in the Softmax Snippets emitter/kernel for small/odd input shapes (e.g., [1,17]) on ARM64, since the magnitude of the actual value (2.6e+23) is characteristic of reading garbage memory rather than a precision issue.
prevention_strategies: Add memory sanitizer (ASan/MSan) coverage for the Snippets Softmax kernel in CI to catch uninitialized reads before they manifest as sporadic accuracy failures. Consider marking this specific parameterized case as retry-eligible via the workflow rerunner once the rerun_search_string is approved.
historical_context: Identical failure signature (2330f1abe60fbda7) seen twice before: run 34454632400 (PR #38056, 2026-09-10) and run 33751824393 (PR #37526, 2026-09-03), both unrelated PRs, confirming this is a recurring flaky test rather than a regression caused by any single PR.
